name: streamergames
description: Multiplayer boardgame companion app for Twitch streams — chat viewers become players alongside the streamer

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix server && npm run test:coverage --prefix client
